prompt: Show that the SI base units of force are kg m s^-2.

mark_scheme.criterion: States F = ma and substitutes units: kg for mass and m s^-2 for acceleration to give kg m s^-2.

hints: Use Newton's second law formula F = ma.
Identify the base unit of each quantity on the right-hand side.
solution: From F = ma, mass has unit kg and acceleration has unit m s^-2. Multiplying gives kg m s^-2.
teacher_walkthrough: State the defining formula F = ma.
Substitute base units: [m] = kg, [a] = m s^-2.
Combine to conclude [F] = kg m s^-2.
